description:
Prunes are ready for harvest by mid-August. The fruit is shaken from the tree mechanically, collected by fabric catching frame and transferred to bins by conveyor belts. The bins of prunes are then transported to the prune dehydrator. At the dehydrator the bins of prunes are dumped one at a time, washed in water, placed on wooden trays and tunnel-dried to about 21 percent moisture. When dry, the prunes are then scraped off the trays and placed in storage bins. After a few days the prunes are turned into an empty bin to cure the dried fruit.

Las ciruelas pasas están listas para la cosecha a mediados de agosto. La fruta se sacude del árbol mecánicamente, se recoge por el marco de captura de tela y se transfiere a los contenedores por cintas transportadoras. Los contenedores de ciruelas pasas se transportan al deshidratador de ciruelas. En el deshidratador, los contenedores de ciruelas pasas se vierten de una a la vez, se lavan en agua, se colocan en bandejas de madera y se secan en túnel a aproximadamente 21 por ciento de humedad. Cuando se seca, las ciruelas pasas se raspan de las bandejas y se colocan en cubos de almacenamiento. Después de unos días, las ciruelas pasas se convierten en un contenedor vacío para curar la fruta seca.

Pflaumen sind bis Mitte August erntfertig. Die Frucht wird mechanisch vom Baum geschüttelt, durch Stofffangrahmen gesammelt und durch Förderbänder in Mülleimer übertragen. Die Behälter der Pflaumen werden dann zum Pflaumen-Dehydrator transportiert. Beim Dehydrator werden die Behälter der Pflaumen einzeln entsorgt, in Wasser gewaschen, auf Holztabletts gelegt und auf etwa 21 Prozent Feuchtigkeit getaucht. Wenn sie trocken sind, werden die Pflaumen dann von den Tabletts abkratzt und in Aufbewahrungsboxen gelegt. Nach einigen Tagen werden die Pflaumen in einen leeren Behälter verwandelt, um das getrocknete Obst zu härten.

description: Jin Ying Zi (Rosa laevigata) is a climbing rose native to fields, thickets, farms and low-elevation mountain areas in China. It was first brought to the U.S. in early colonial times. At one point, it acquired the common name of Cherokee rose (which it retains) in large part because it was being cultivated and widely distributed by Cherokee Indians. In 1916, under the mistaken belief that it was a U.S. native plant, it was designated as the state flower of Georgia. It has now naturalized throughout much of the southeastern U.S. from North Carolina to Florida west to Texas. This is an evergreen (in mild climates) climber that will grow to 6-20’ long on arching stems armed with hooked thorns. It also can be grown as a sprawling free-standing shrub. Stems are clad with trifoliate dark green leaves with coarsely toothed leaflets. Single, fragrant white flowers (to 4” diameter) with scalloped petals and yellow stamens bloom for several weeks in spring. Unfortunately there is no repeat bloom. Flowers are followed by large, bristly orange-red hips (to 2” long).

description: Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

description: Jin Ying Zi (Rosa laevigata) is a climbing rose native to fields, thickets, farms and low-elevation mountain areas in China. It was first brought to the U.S. in early colonial times. At one point, it acquired the common name of Cherokee rose (which it retains) in large part because it was being cultivated and widely distributed by Cherokee Indians. In 1916, under the mistaken belief that it was a U.S. native plant, it was designated as the state flower of Georgia. It has now naturalized throughout much of the southeastern U.S. from North Carolina to Florida west to Texas. This is an evergreen (in mild climates) climber that will grow to 6-20’ long on arching stems armed with hooked thorns. It also can be grown as a sprawling free-standing shrub. Stems are clad with trifoliate dark green leaves with coarsely toothed leaflets. Single, fragrant white flowers (to 4” diameter) with scalloped petals and yellow stamens bloom for several weeks in spring. Unfortunately there is no repeat bloom. Flowers are followed by large, bristly orange-red hips (to 2” long).

description:
What Is Coconut Water Powder?

Coconut water powder is made by dehydrating the liquid found inside coconuts (often referred to as coconut water or coconut juice). The remaining powder is called coconut water powder and can be reconstituted or used in baking.

Coconuts are the fruits that grow on the coconut tree (Cocos nucifera), native to tropical coastal regions. Coconuts are a type of drupe, despite their name containing the word "nut." They are unique in that they have hard shells that contain a water-like liquid and white pulp. Both the pulp and the liquid offer numerous benefits.

Coconut Water Powder Benefits

Coconut water powder is loaded with vitamins and minerals, including vitamin B6, iron, and potassium. Its high electrolyte content makes it ideal for sports drinks and maintaining hydration during exercise.* It's often used as part of pre-workout regimens, as well. Coconut water powder also helps support the heart and cardiovascular system.*

description:
What Is Coconut Water Powder?

Coconut water powder is made by dehydrating the liquid found inside coconuts (often referred to as coconut water or coconut juice). The remaining powder is called coconut water powder and can be reconstituted or used in baking.

Coconuts are the fruits that grow on the coconut tree (Cocos nucifera), native to tropical coastal regions. Coconuts are a type of drupe, despite their name containing the word "nut." They are unique in that they have hard shells that contain a water-like liquid and white pulp. Both the pulp and the liquid offer numerous benefits.

Coconut Water Powder Benefits

Coconut water powder is loaded with vitamins and minerals, including vitamin B6, iron, and potassium. Its high electrolyte content makes it ideal for sports drinks and maintaining hydration during exercise.* It's often used as part of pre-workout regimens, as well. Coconut water powder also helps support the heart and cardiovascular system.*

description: Rose flower water (aka rose petals water) is a clear, perfumed distillation of fresh rose petal blossoms. This essential water has traditionally been used in many French and Mediterranean dessert dishes, but has more recently found its way into Western cuisine. For example, rose flower water is used in France to flavor crepes, in Mexico to flavor little wedding cakes, and in the United States to make pastry. Rose flower water is also used as an ingredient in some cocktails. It has been a traditional ingredient used often in Middle Eastern cooking. In the Arab world, it is frequently added to hard or otherwise bad-tasting drinking water to mask the unpleasant flavor. Rose blossoms are believed to be used in this manner because they are seen as the traditional bridal flower and, therefore, symbolize purity (white, small and delicate). Rose water for skincare is a different product, this is culinary only, not recommended for skincare.

description: Kissel or kisel (Estonian: kissell, Finnish: kiisseli, Latgalian: keiseļs, Latvian: ķīselis, Lithuanian: kisielius, Polish: kisiel, Russian: кисель, kisél’, Ukrainian: кисiль, Belarusian: кісель, kisél') is a viscous fruit dish, popular as a dessert and as a drink.[1][2] It consists of the sweetened juice of berries, like mors, but it is thickened with cornstarch, potato starch or arrowroot; sometimes red wine or fresh or dried fruits are added.[2] It is similar to the Danish rødgrød and German Rote Grütze.[1] Swedish blåbärssoppa is a similarly prepared bilberry dessert, although only fresh or frozen bilberries, not dried berries are used to prepare it.[original research?] Kissel can be served either hot or cold, also together with sweetened quark or semolina pudding. Kissel can also be served on pancakes or with ice cream. If the kissel is made using less thickening starch, it can be drunk — this is common in Russia and Ukraine.

title: Vita Coco Coconut Water, Pure, 33.8 Fl Oz
bullet_point: [Pure vitamin and mineral rich coconut water, Great source of potassium, fat and cholesterol free, Comes in eco- and socially-responsible Tetra Pak packaging, Kosher, gluten-free, and vegan-approved, Hydrate naturally]
description:
Not so long ago, you had to use a machete if you wanted a sip of pure coconut water. We've taken the machete out of the equation, which is good, because those things are dangerous. Now all that's left is Mother Nature's most hydrating, refreshing, vitamin- and mineral-rich nectar. Vita Coco is never made from concentrate. That means we pick, crack, and pack fresh young coconuts directly at the source. After the coconuts are cleaned, the delicate water inside is flash pasteurized (and occasionally mixed with all-natural fruit puree) then poured into a shelf-stable Tetra Pak. The entire process from tree to Pak doesn't exceed 72 hours. We hear the end result is a lot like sticking a straw in a coconut.

No hace mucho tiempo, tuviste que usar un machete si querías un sorbo de agua pura de coco. Hemos sacado el machete de la ecuación, lo cual es bueno, porque esas cosas son peligrosas. Ahora todo lo que queda es el néctar más hidratante, refrescante, rico en vitaminas y minerales. Vita Coco nunca está hecho de concentrado. Eso significa que recogemos, agrietamos y empacamos cocos jóvenes frescos directamente en la fuente. Después de limpiar los cocos, el delicado agua interior es pasteurizado (y de vez en cuando se mezcla con puré de fruta totalmente natural) y luego se vierte en un Tetra Pak estable en estante. Todo el proceso de árbol a Pak no supera las 72 horas. Oímos que el resultado final es mucho como pegar una paja en un coco.

לא כל כך מזמן, הייתם צריכים להשתמש במצ'טה אם רצית לגימה של מי קוקוס טהורים. הוצאנו את המצ'טה מהמשוואה, וזה טוב, כי הדברים האלה מסוכנים. עכשיו כל מה שנשאר הוא הצוף העשיר ביותר של אמא טבע, מרענן, בוויטמינים ומינרלים. Vita Coco אף פעם לא עשוי מתרכיז. זה אומר שאנחנו בוחרים, נסדקים, ואורזים אגוזי קוקוס טריים צעירים ישירות למקור. לאחר ניקוי אגוזי הקוקוס, המים העדינים בפנים מפוסטרים (ולפעמים מעורבבים עם מחית פירות טבעית) ואז נשפכים לתוך חבילת טטרה יציבה מדף. התהליך כולו מעץ ל-Pak אינו עולה על 72 שעות. אנחנו שומעים שהתוצאה הסופית דומה מאוד לתקוע קש בקוקוס.

Vor nicht so lange, mussten Sie eine Machete verwenden, wenn Sie einen Schluck reines Kokosnusswasser wollten. Wir haben die Machete aus der Gleichung genommen, die gut ist, denn diese Dinge sind gefährlich. Nun ist alles, was übrig bleibt, der feuchtigkeitsspendendste, erfrischende, vitamin- und mineralreiche Nektar. Vita Coco wird nie aus Konzentrat hergestellt. Das heißt, wir pflücken, knacken und verpacken frische junge Kokosnüsse direkt an der Quelle. Nachdem die Kokosnüsse gereinigt wurden, wird das empfindliche Wasser im Inneren pasteurisiert (und gelegentlich mit naturbelassenem Fruchtpüree) und dann in ein regalstabiles Tetra-Pak gegossen. Der gesamte Prozess von Baum zu Pak beträgt 72 Stunden. Wir hören, dass das Endergebnis sehr ist, als würde man einen Strohhalm in eine Kokosnuss kleben.

منذ وقت ليس كثيرًا، عليك استخدام المنجل إذا كنت تريد رشفة من ماء جوز الهند النقي. لقد أخرجنا المنجل من معادلة جيدة، لأن هذه الأشياء خطيرة. الآن كل ما يتبقى هو أكثر أنواع الرحيق رطوبة وانتعاشًا من الطبيعة الأم الغنية بالفيتامينات والمعادن. فيتا كوكو لم يتم صناعتها من مواد مركزة. وهذا يعني أننا نقوم بالتقاط ونكسر ونعبئ جوز الهند الصغير الطازج مباشرة من المصدر. بعد تنظيف جوز الهند، يتم تعقيم الماء الرقيق بالداخل بشكل فلاش (ويختلط أحيانًا مع الفواكه النقية الطبيعية) ثم يُسكب في عبوة تيترا ثابتة على الرف. لا تتجاوز العملية بأكملها من شجرة إلى باك 72 ساعة. نسمع أن النتيجة النهائية تشبه كثيرًا لصق المصاصة في جوز الهند.

Não muito tempo atrás, você tinha que usar um machete se você queria um gole de água pura de coco. Nós tiramos o facão da equação, o que é bom, porque essas coisas são perigosas. Agora tudo o que resta é o néctar mais hidratante, refrescante, rico em vitaminas e minerais. A Vita Coco nunca é feita de concentrado. Isso significa que pegamos, rachamos e embalamos cocos frescos diretamente na fonte. Depois que os cocos forem limpos, a delicada água interna é pasteurizada (e ocasionalmente misturada com purê de fruta natural) e depois despejada em uma Tetra Pak estável na prateleira. Todo o processo de árvore a Pak não excede 72 horas. Ouvimos que o resultado final é muito parecido colar um canudo em um coco.

不久前,如果您想要一口纯椰子水,您必须使用弯刀。 我们已经把弯刀带走了那种好处,因为这些东西是危险的。 现在剩下的就是大自然母亲最保湿、清爽、富含维生素和矿物质的花蜜。 Vita Coco 从来没有浓缩。 这意味着我们直接从源头采摘、开裂和包装新鲜的椰子。 清洁椰子后,内部的精致水会被快速巴氏消毒(偶尔与全天然水果泥混合),然后倒入稳定的利乐包。 从树到Pak 的整个过程不超过 72 小时。 我们听说最终的结果很像在椰子中粘一根吸管。

不久前,如果你想要一口純椰子水,你就必須使用彎刀 。 我們已經將大砍刀從方程中取出,這很好,因為那些東西很危險。 現在,剩下的是 Mother Nature 最保濕、清新、富含維他命和礦物質的花蜜。 Vita Coco 從未以濃縮材料製成。 這意味著我們直接在來源處挑選、開裂和包裝新鮮的椰子。 ​ 清潔椰子後,內部的精緻水會經過火烈巴氏殺菌 (偶爾會與全天然果泥混合),然後倒入擱架穩定的 Tetra Pak 利樂。 從樹到柏木的整個過程不超過 72 小時。 我們聽說最終的結果就像在椰子中粘一根吸管。

그리 오래 전부터 순수 코코넛 물을 원한다면 마체테를 사용해야 했습니다. 우리는 방정식에서 machete를 꺼내었습니다. 이는 위험하기 때문입니다. 이제 남은 것은 대자연에서 가장 촉촉하고 상쾌하며 비타민과 미네랄이 풍부한 과즙입니다. Vita Coco는 농축액으로 만들어지지 않았습니다. 즉, 우리가 신선한 어린 코코넛을 직접 고르고 균열하며 포장합니다. 코코넛을 씻은 후, 내부의 섬세한 물은 플래시 살균(그리고 때로는 천연 과일 퓨레와 혼합) 후 선반 안정적인 Tetra Pak에 붓습니다. 나무에서 팩까지 전체 과정은 72시간을 초과하지 않습니다. 최종 결과는 코코넛에 빨대를 붙이는 것과 같습니다.

History of Yogurt: Yogurt making appears to have originated in the Middle East and Central Asia, even though researchers have been unable to pin down the exact time frame for this development. Camels, sheep, goats, and other animals were the primary sources of milk for yogurt since cows had yet to be domesticated. (In North America, buffalo and bison milk are two further examples of animal milks used to make yogurt prior to the domestication of cows.) Many cultures also developed techniques for drying their liquid yogurt so that it had a longer shelf life and could be more easily stored and transported. It became very common for certain nomadic cultures to rely on dried yogurt as part of their staple food. Today, cow's milk has become the primary source for commercially produced yogurt, and this food is enjoyed in fresh liquid form worldwide. Yogurt consumption in the U.S. is about 4 times greater than it was in the 1980's, and averages about 11-12 pounds per person per year. (This amount is much smaller than would be found in other parts of the world. For example, in Europe, yogurt consumption averages closer to 65-70 pounds per person). Nearly 4 billion pounds of yogurt are manufactured annually in the U.S. each year, and due to the increasing popularity of Greek-style yogurt, nearly 1.5 billion pounds are manufactured in that form.

bullet_point: [Cellular rejuvenation, Healthy inflammatory responses, Immunity, Cardiovascular health, Antioxidant levels]
description:
The Queen of Fruits
Regarded as the "Queen of Fruits" in Southeast Asia, the mangosteen fruit is one of the most prized superfruits in the world. This superfruit consists of an inner white flesh that has a sweet and tangy flavor, with a dark purple, bitter, and leathery outer rind. It is in the tough outer rind of the fruit where the polyphenols, including the xanthones and tannins can be found. These polyphenols are responsible for the fruit's survival properties. Genesis Today uses a special proprietary blending process to ensure we receive the beneficial antioxidants contained within the rind. The end result is our pure, and strong, organic mangosteen liquid super concentrate, that offers trace vitamins and minerals, and a generous amount of xanthones in every ounce.
Pure, Wild-Harvested & Organic
What makes our supplements so unique? We have only one ingredient: "100% pure superfruit." Each superfruit supplement is 100% pure superfruit juice derived entirely from the fruit, processed by traditional methods used in each country of origin. There are no additives or fillers, and we never dilute our supplements with water or fruit juices. They're simply 100% pure, USDA certified organic, wild-harvested superfruits from Genesis Today's Superfood Farms.
Suggested Use
As a liquid dietary supplement, take 1 fl oz in the morning and again in the afternoon. Additional 1 fl oz servings may be taken throughout the day if desired. Organic Mangosteen 100 can also be mixed with your favorite natural juice, or with our popular Organic Goji 100 for the "Ultimate Tonic."

description:
What Is Coconut Water Powder?

Coconut water powder is made by dehydrating the liquid found inside coconuts (often referred to as coconut water or coconut juice). The remaining powder is called coconut water powder and can be reconstituted or used in baking.

Coconuts are the fruits that grow on the coconut tree (Cocos nucifera), native to tropical coastal regions. Coconuts are a type of drupe, despite their name containing the word "nut." They are unique in that they have hard shells that contain a water-like liquid and white pulp. Both the pulp and the liquid offer numerous benefits.

Coconut Water Powder Benefits

Coconut water powder is loaded with vitamins and minerals, including vitamin B6, iron, and potassium. Its high electrolyte content makes it ideal for sports drinks and maintaining hydration during exercise.* It's often used as part of pre-workout regimens, as well. Coconut water powder also helps support the heart and cardiovascular system.*

description:
​The Caribe Story

The story of Caribe begins when we noticed juice offerings did not match the quality of flavor or experience we had grown accustomed to drinking when living in the Dominican Republic, where natural, fresh tasting, nutrient packed juices are a cultural staple. Today we are proud to say that we offer our portfolio of cold pressed juices made from exotic fruits, all of which are ethically sourced from small farms in the Caribbean. This helps farmers sell their fruit abroad, giving them access to different markets they otherwise would not be able to reach

Star fruit (Carambola)

Star fruit, known as Carambola in the Dominican Republic, is known in English as such because it looks like a five pointed star when cut at the top. It is one of the very low-calorie exotic fruits. 100g fruit just provides 31 calories. It is also rich in antioxidants and is an excellent source of Vitamin C, potassium; and low in sugar and sodium.

Limon (Lime)

The health benefits of lime include weight loss, improved digestion, reduced respiratory and urinary disorders, relief from constipation, and treatment of scurvy, piles, peptic ulcer, gout, and gums. It also aids in skin care and eye care. Lime consists of water and is an extremely good source of vitamin C. It is also rich in dietary fiber and minerals like calcium, iron, potassium, copper, magnesium, and phosphorous. The best thing about lime is that it has the least amount of calories, carbohydrates, and fats.

Our Secret Touch: Caña

We blend our fruits with pressed caña (cane juice), to boost nutrition and sweetness Caribé-style. Known for Vitamin B5, minerals, antioxidants, and its low glycemic impact, this is truly an island treasure.

description: Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

THE AÇAI BERRY
Acai (Ah-sigh-EE) - (Euterpe Oleracea or the Brazilian Date Palm Berry) is grown in the Amazon flood basin. Acai is a slender multi-stemmed palm producing a dark purple, round berry, which is more seed than berry. Each tree produces 3 to 4 branches of fruit with each branch accounting for 3 to 6 kilograms of fruit. The natives call this phenomenal fruit their superfood. They eat it as a main course with veggies or sea food. They also add sugar to make it into a dessert.

DR. TIM'S BRAZILIAN ACAI
Each harvest is inspected and selected for its superior quality, flavor and color. These are the benchmarks for optimum bioactivity of the nutrients, vitamins and other useful compounds found naturally in this tree ripened fruit. Our Acai is wild-harvested which in turn protects the future of the Amazon rain forest by making the trees more valuable than deforested ground. So every time you drink Dr. Tim's Brazilian Acai, you are saving the local rain forest and providing work and economic stability to these beautiful and remote areas of the world.

The Acai berries are then processed using the Cryoflux Technology which is an exclusive method developed by Dr. Tim in order to protect the natural bio-activity and nutrients in the juice. The process also helps in converting Acai berries into a tasty, healthy drink. His Acai juice is not only the most potent around, it contains all the nutrients and retains the flavorful taste of the fruit.	

Our Acai Juice does not contain added water, sugar or anything artificial.
Most of our competitors only add 10% of their Acai Juice in their final product.
Our Acai Juice contains over 80% pure juice! We do not use powders or added water in our juice!
We offer guaranteed lab analysis of our Acai Juice.
We can offer low prices since we control our Acai Juice from source to a finished bottle.
Our Acai Juice is bottled in a USDA approved facility.

description: Ingredients: Banana powder, creamer, Yogurt powder and sugar. What is Yogurt? Yogurt is a semisolid sourish food prepared from milk fermented by added bacteria, often sweetened and flavored. Here are just a few benefits of the countless benefits: Helps balance Probiotics for healthy digestion. Reported to help prevent Osteoporosis. Known to reduce the risk of high blood pressure. Helps overall digestive health. May help reduce hunger. Boosts your immune system. History of Yogurt: Yogurt making appears to have originated in the Middle East and Central Asia, even though researchers have been unable to pin down the exact time frame for this development. Camels, sheep, goats, and other animals were the primary sources of milk for yogurt since cows had yet to be domesticated. (In North America, buffalo and bison milk are two further examples of animal milks used to make yogurt prior to the domestication of cows.) Many cultures also developed techniques for drying their liquid yogurt so that it had a longer shelf life and could be more easily stored and transported. It became very common for certain nomadic cultures to rely on dried yogurt as part of their staple food. Today, cow's milk has become the primary source for commercially produced yogurt, and this food is enjoyed in fresh liquid form worldwide. Yogurt consumption in the U.S. is about 4 times greater than it was in the 1980's, and averages about 11-12 pounds per person per year. (This amount is much smaller than would be found in other parts of the world. For example, in Europe, yogurt consumption averages closer to 65-70 pounds per person). Nearly 4 billion pounds of yogurt are manufactured annually in the U.S. each year, and due to the increasing popularity of Greek-style yogurt, nearly 1.5 billion pounds are manufactured in that form.

description: Indian Gooseberry is a fibrous fruits containing fibers and microfibers which are considered vital to the nutrition value that the fruit is known for. As our aim is to deliver a juice to the end consumer that is as nutritiously similar to the actual fruit we intentionally add fiber from the fruit back into the juice. The majority of our competitors simply boil the powder and add that to water to make juice. Amla grows on a deciduous tree of the Phyllanthaceae family. Amla fruit is nearly spherical, light greenish yellow, smooth and hard on appearance, with six vertical stripes or furrows. Amla taste is best described as sour, bitter and astringent. According to Ayurveda, Amla is purported to deliver a cooling effect on the body. description:
Gold Medal Process

PICKED
The Martinelli’s Gold Medal process begins with a blend of U.S. grown fresh apples of the finest varieties, including the flavorful Newtown Pippin, which helps us achieve the perfect balance of sweetness and tartness with no concentrates or chemical additives.

PRESSED
The apples are thoroughly washed and hand-sorted to remove any defects and then ground to a pulp and cold pressed to release the delicious fresh juice.

PASTEURIZED
Our premium 100% juice is then flash-pasteurized, hot-filled into new bottles, capped and quickly cooled to retain the fresh apple flavor. Our Sparkling Cider and other sparkling 100% juices are carbonated, cold-filled, capped, then slowly pasteurized and cooled in the bottle. Both end-processes result in product purity and quality for extended shelf life without chemical preservatives. The most sophisticated quality control methods are applied at every step in Martinelli’s Gold Medal process to ensure superior quality.

bullet_point: [Cold Stored In Our Climate/Light Controlled Warehouse!, Made From Farm Fresh Kale!, One Tablespoon Equals Multiple Servings of Fresh Kale!]
description: Get over 100 single teaspoon servings from one pound of our farm fresh kale JUICE powder. Direct from the growers to our herb store comes this finely prepared vegetable superfood powder. Our kale JUICE powder is gently dried in low heat to preserve its nutrient composition. Just 1-2 teaspoons of this superfood JUICE powder in a daily health drink or smoothie adds a blast of healthy nutrients to your body! Our juice powders are many times more nutrient dense than our standard kale powder. What Is The Difference Between Standard Superfood Powders & Juice Powders? This is one question that we hear very often. Many people are a bit confused on the difference between our standard herb powders (e.g. Kale Powder, Acai Berry Powder, Wheatgrass Powder, etc.) and our juice powders (e.g. Kale Juice Powder, Acai Berry Juice Powder, Wheatgrass Juice Powder, etc.). To answer the question clearly, picture a bag full of fresh picked and dried kale and a glass of freshly squeezed kale juice. To make our standard berry powder the bag of kale is simply dried and ground up into a powder. To make our juice powder the kale is squeezed to first make the juice and then the juice is dried to make the juice powder. So how is the juice powder more nutrient dense? Well, let's say that it takes 5-10 lbs of kale to make 1 pound of kale powder. Take the same kale and figure that the same 5-10 lbs will make approx. 64 fluid ounces of kale juice. Now that juice is freeze dried to make only about 6-10 ounces or so of pure juice powder. So you see it takes a whole lot more kale to make our juice powders than our regular powders. See, it's really not that complicated after all.

description: Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

description:

product description
Verjus (pronounced vair-ZHOO) is the tart, fresh juice of unripe wine grapes. It is a culinary ingredient indigenous to the world's wine producing regions that is used in sauce making, for poaching fish and meat, and to dress lettuces, vegetables and fruit. Verjus or "verjuice" as it is sometimes called, literally means green juice in the sense that it's made from fruit that has yet to fully ripen - it's green. It is used to add acidity to foods, an important component in food and in cooking. 
Napa Valley Verjus is made from white wine varieties such as Chardonnay, and the wine grapes removed from the vine in midsummer, at a point in the growing cycle called veraison. At veraison, change in color from green to black and the berries begin to soften enough to press. 

As the grapes arrive at the winery, they are loaded into large pneumatic presses where the juice is gently extracted then transferred to refrigerated stainless steel tanks. The juice is allowed to settle for a couple of days, then it is lightly filtered and packaged. 

The fresh verjus is at its best right after pressing, and can be packaged immediately. The challenging part of the production is keeping the verjus from fermenting and becoming wine; crushed grapes will spontaneously ferment due to airborne yeasts. 

Commercially, grape juice is usually stabilized by either adding powerful preservatives like benzoic acid, or by traditional canning methods - the juice must be heated to a temperature high enough to kill yeast cells and bacteria. Both of these methods adversely affect the taste of the finished product.

description: Jin Ying Zi (Rosa laevigata) is a climbing rose native to fields, thickets, farms and low-elevation mountain areas in China. It was first brought to the U.S. in early colonial times. It has now naturalized throughout much of the southeastern U.S. from North Carolina to Florida west to Texas. description: Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

description:
Not so long ago, you had to use a machete if you wanted a sip of pure coconut water. We’ve taken the machete out of the equation, which is good, because those things are dangerous. Now all that’s left is Mother Nature’s most hydrating, refreshing, vitamin- and mineral-rich nectar. Vita Coco is never made from concentrate. That means we pick, crack, and pack fresh young coconuts directly at the source. After the coconuts are cleaned, the delicate water inside is flash pasteurized (and occasionally mixed with all-natural fruit puree) then poured into a shelf-stable Tetra Pak. The entire process from tree to Pak doesn't exceed 72 hours. We hear the end result is a lot like sticking a straw in a coconut.

No hace mucho tiempo, tuviste que usar un machete si querías un sorbo de agua pura de coco. Hemos sacado el machete de la ecuación, lo cual es bueno, porque esas cosas son peligrosas. Ahora todo lo que queda es el néctar más hidratante, refrescante, rico en vitaminas y minerales. Vita Coco nunca está hecho de concentrado. Eso significa que recogemos, agrietamos y empacamos cocos jóvenes frescos directamente en la fuente. Después de limpiar los cocos, el delicado agua interior es pasteurizado (y de vez en cuando se mezcla con puré de fruta totalmente natural) y luego se vierte en un Tetra Pak estable en estante. Todo el proceso de árbol a Pak no supera las 72 horas. Oímos que el resultado final es mucho como pegar una paja en un coco.

לא כל כך מזמן, הייתם צריכים להשתמש במצ'טה אם רצית לגימה של מי קוקוס טהורים. הוצאנו את המצ'טה מהמשוואה, וזה טוב, כי הדברים האלה מסוכנים. עכשיו כל מה שנשאר הוא הצוף העשיר ביותר של אמא טבע, מרענן, בוויטמינים ומינרלים. Vita Coco אף פעם לא עשוי מתרכיז. זה אומר שאנחנו בוחרים, נסדקים, ואורזים אגוזי קוקוס טריים צעירים ישירות למקור. לאחר ניקוי אגוזי הקוקוס, המים העדינים בפנים מפוסטרים (ולפעמים מעורבבים עם מחית פירות טבעית) ואז נשפכים לתוך חבילת טטרה יציבה מדף. התהליך כולו מעץ ל-Pak אינו עולה על 72 שעות. אנחנו שומעים שהתוצאה הסופית דומה מאוד לתקוע קש בקוקוס.

Nun ist alles, was übrig bleibt, der feuchtigkeitsspendendste, erfrischende, vitamin- und mineralreiche Nektar. Vita Coco wird nie aus Konzentrat hergestellt. Das heißt, wir pflücken, knacken und verpacken frische junge Kokosnüsse direkt an der Quelle. Nachdem die Kokosnüsse gereinigt wurden, wird das empfindliche Wasser im Inneren pasteurisiert (und gelegentlich mit naturbelassenem Fruchtpüree) und dann in ein regalstabiles Tetra-Pak gegossen. Der gesamte Prozess von Baum zu Pak beträgt 72 Stunden. Wir hören, dass das Endergebnis sehr ist, als würde man einen Strohhalm in eine Kokosnuss kleben.

منذ وقت ليس كثيرًا، عليك استخدام المنجل إذا كنت تريد رشفة من ماء جوز الهند النقي. لقد أخرجنا المنجل من معادلة جيدة، لأن هذه الأشياء خطيرة. الآن كل ما يتبقى هو أكثر أنواع الرحيق رطوبة وانتعاشًا من الطبيعة الأم الغنية بالفيتامينات والمعادن. فيتا كوكو لم يتم صناعتها من مواد مركزة. وهذا يعني أننا نقوم بالتقاط ونكسر ونعبئ جوز الهند الصغير الطازج مباشرة من المصدر. بعد تنظيف جوز الهند، يتم تعقيم الماء الرقيق بالداخل بشكل فلاش (ويختلط أحيانًا مع الفواكه النقية الطبيعية) ثم يُسكب في عبوة تيترا ثابتة على الرف. لا تتجاوز العملية بأكملها من شجرة إلى باك 72 ساعة. نسمع أن النتيجة النهائية تشبه كثيرًا لصق المصاصة في جوز الهند.

不久前,如果您想要一口纯椰子水,您必须使用弯刀。 我们已经把弯刀带走了那种好处,因为这些东西是危险的。 现在剩下的就是大自然母亲最保湿、清爽、富含维生素和矿物质的花蜜。 Vita Coco 从来没有浓缩。 这意味着我们直接从源头采摘、开裂和包装新鲜的椰子。 清洁椰子后,内部的精致水会被快速巴氏消毒(偶尔与全天然水果泥混合),然后倒入稳定的利乐包。 从树到Pak 的整个过程不超过 72 小时。 我们听说最终的结果很像在椰子中粘一根吸管。

description:
Bursting with the tart flavors and aromas of fresh grapefruit, Sanpellegrino Pompelmo (Grapefruit) Sparkling Fruit Beverage refreshes your palate with the delightfully tart and sweet taste and pleasantly smooth finish of sun-ripened grapefruit. This traditional Italian beverage is made with real grapefruit juice, bubbly sparkling water and real sugar. Simply peel back the foil on the can and enjoy the Life Deliziosa. Since 1932, Sanpellegrino has crafted sparkling fruit beverages inspired by homemade Aranciata, a traditional Italian beverage made with fruit juice, carbonated water and real sugar. With this inspiration, we’ve created a variety of non-alcoholic citrus flavored sparkling beverages featuring fruit juice and authentic ingredients. Our sparkling fruit beverages have no artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners or preservatives. Sanpellegrino Pompelmo is the perfect thirst quencher for a hot summer afternoon, it is delicious on it's own and can also be paired with fresh fruits and spices to create a unique cocktail experience. Open a can and with just one sip of a Sanpellegrino Grapefruit Sparkling Fruit Beverage, you’ll be transported to the sun-drenched citrus groves of Southern Italy, allowing you to enjoy the Life Deliziosa any time.

משקאות פירות נוצצים של אשכולית רעננה, Sanpellegrino Pompelmo (אשכולית) מרעננים את החיך שלכם עם טעם עוגה מתוק וגימור חלק ונעים של אשכולית הבשלת שמש. המשקה האיטלקי המסורתי הזה עשוי מיץ אשכולית אמיתי, מים נוצצים מבעבעים וסוכר אמיתי. פשוט קלפו את נייר הכסף על הפחית ותיהנו מ-Life Deliziosa. מאז 1932, Sanpellegrino יצרה משקאות פירות נוצצים בהשראת Aranciata תוצרת בית, משקה איטלקי מסורתי העשוי ממיץ פירות, מים מוגזים וסוכר אמיתי. בהשראה זו, יצרנו מגוון של משקאות נוצצים שאינם אלכוהוליים בטעם הדרים הכוללים מיץ פירות ומרכיבים אותנטיים. למשקאות הפירות הנוצצים שלנו אין צבעים מלאכותיים, טעמים, ממתיקים או חומרים משמרים. Dieses traditionelle italienische Getränk wird mit echtem Grapefruit-Saft, sprudelnd sprudelndem Wasser und echtem Zucker hergestellt. Einfach die Folie auf der Dose abziehen und das Leben Deliziosa genießen. Seit 1932 fertigt Sanpellegrino sprudelnde Fruchtgetränke, die von hausgemachten Aranciata inspiriert sind, ein traditionelles italienisches Getränk aus Fruchtsaft, kohlensäurehaltigem Wasser und echtem Zucker. Mit dieser Inspiration haben wir eine Vielzahl von nicht-alkoholischen Getränken mit Zitrusgeschmack kreiert, die Fruchtsaft und authentischen Zutaten enthält. Unsere sprudelnden Fruchtgetränke haben keine künstlichen Farbstoffe, Aromen, Süßstoffe oder Konservierungsstoffe. Sanpellegrino Pompelmo ist der perfekte Durstlöscher für einen heißen Sommernachmittag, er ist von alleine köstlich und kann auch mit frischen Früchten und Gewürzen kombiniert werden, um ein einzigartiges Cocktailerlebnis zu schaffen. Öffnen Sie eine Dose und mit nur einem Schluck eines Sanpellegrino Grapefruit Sparkling Fruit Drink werden Sie in die sonnenverwöhnten Zitrushaine Süditaliens transportiert, so dass Sie die Deliziosa jederzeit genießen können.

Here at Ocean Spray we like cranberries. We really, really like cranberries. We probably know cranberries better than anyone. But the funny thing is most people don't know that much about them. We'd like to change that. Cranberries are actually one of the most unique fruits in the world. In fact, it's only one of three fruits that are native to North America. They are a wild fruit that grow on long-running vines in sandy bogs and marshes. Mostly in the northeast, but also in other parts of North America, like Wisconsin and the Pacific Northwest. Rehydrate the desired quantity of yeasts in 10 times its weight of water at 35-38°C. Stir avoiding the formation of lumps and leave to rest for 15 minutes. Progressively add must from the tank (2 or 3 additions) so that the temperature difference between the yeast starter and the initial must does not exceed 10°C. This stage allows the yeast to become acclimatized and avoids a thermal shock. Example: If must that needs to be pitched is 14°C, the yeast starter temperature should not be more than 24°C prior to inoculation. Stir and leave to rest for ~8-10 minutes after each must additions. Incorporate the yeast starter in the fermentation tank during a pumping over with aeration. The rehydration procedure should not exceed 45 minutes.

description: This essential water has traditionally been used in many French and Mediterranean dessert dishes, but has more recently found its way into Western cuisine. For example, orange flower water is used in France to flavor madeleines, in Mexico to flavor little wedding cakes, and in the United States to make orange blossom scones. Orange flower water is also used as an ingredient in some cocktails, such as the Ramos Gin Fizz. It has been a traditional ingredient used often in Middle Eastern cooking. In the Arab world, it is frequently added to hard or otherwise bad-tasting drinking water to mask the unpleasant flavor. Orange blossoms are believed to be used in this manner because they are seen as the traditional bridal flower and, therefore, symbolize purity (white, small and delicate).

title: Vita Coco Coconut Water, Pure, 33.8 Fl Oz
bullet_point: [Pure vitamin and mineral rich coconut water, Great source of potassium, fat and cholesterol free, Comes in eco- and socially-responsible Tetra Pak packaging, Kosher, gluten-free, and vegan-approved, Hydrate naturally]
description:
Not so long ago, you had to use a machete if you wanted a sip of pure coconut water. We've taken the machete out of the equation, which is good, because those things are dangerous. Now all that's left is Mother Nature's most hydrating, refreshing, vitamin- and mineral-rich nectar. Vita Coco is never made from concentrate. That means we pick, crack, and pack fresh young coconuts directly at the source. After the coconuts are cleaned, the delicate water inside is flash pasteurized (and occasionally mixed with all-natural fruit puree) then poured into a shelf-stable Tetra Pak. The entire process from tree to Pak doesn't exceed 72 hours. We hear the end result is a lot like sticking a straw in a coconut.

No hace mucho tiempo, tuviste que usar un machete si querías un sorbo de agua pura de coco. Hemos sacado el machete de la ecuación, lo cual es bueno, porque esas cosas son peligrosas. Ahora todo lo que queda es el néctar más hidratante, refrescante, rico en vitaminas y minerales. Vita Coco nunca está hecho de concentrado. Eso significa que recogemos, agrietamos y empacamos cocos jóvenes frescos directamente en la fuente. Después de limpiar los cocos, el delicado agua interior es pasteurizado (y de vez en cuando se mezcla con puré de fruta totalmente natural) y luego se vierte en un Tetra Pak estable en estante. Todo el proceso de árbol a Pak no supera las 72 horas. Oímos que el resultado final es mucho como pegar una paja en un coco.

לא כל כך מזמן, הייתם צריכים להשתמש במצ'טה אם רצית לגימה של מי קוקוס טהורים. הוצאנו את המצ'טה מהמשוואה, וזה טוב, כי הדברים האלה מסוכנים. עכשיו כל מה שנשאר הוא הצוף העשיר ביותר של אמא טבע, מרענן, בוויטמינים ומינרלים. Vita Coco אף פעם לא עשוי מתרכיז. זה אומר שאנחנו בוחרים, נסדקים, ואורזים אגוזי קוקוס טריים צעירים ישירות למקור. לאחר ניקוי אגוזי הקוקוס, המים העדינים בפנים מפוסטרים (ולפעמים מעורבבים עם מחית פירות טבעית) ואז נשפכים לתוך חבילת טטרה יציבה מדף. התהליך כולו מעץ ל-Pak אינו עולה על 72 שעות. אנחנו שומעים שהתוצאה הסופית דומה מאוד לתקוע קש בקוקוס.

Vor nicht so lange, mussten Sie eine Machete verwenden, wenn Sie einen Schluck reines Kokosnusswasser wollten. Wir haben die Machete aus der Gleichung genommen, die gut ist, denn diese Dinge sind gefährlich. Nun ist alles, was übrig bleibt, der feuchtigkeitsspendendste, erfrischende, vitamin- und mineralreiche Nektar. Vita Coco wird nie aus Konzentrat hergestellt. Das heißt, wir pflücken, knacken und verpacken frische junge Kokosnüsse direkt an der Quelle. Nachdem die Kokosnüsse gereinigt wurden, wird das empfindliche Wasser im Inneren pasteurisiert (und gelegentlich mit naturbelassenem Fruchtpüree) und dann in ein regalstabiles Tetra-Pak gegossen. Der gesamte Prozess von Baum zu Pak beträgt 72 Stunden. Wir hören, dass das Endergebnis sehr ist, als würde man einen Strohhalm in eine Kokosnuss kleben.

منذ وقت ليس كثيرًا، عليك استخدام المنجل إذا كنت تريد رشفة من ماء جوز الهند النقي. لقد أخرجنا المنجل من معادلة جيدة، لأن هذه الأشياء خطيرة. الآن كل ما يتبقى هو أكثر أنواع الرحيق رطوبة وانتعاشًا من الطبيعة الأم الغنية بالفيتامينات والمعادن. فيتا كوكو لم يتم صناعتها من مواد مركزة. وهذا يعني أننا نقوم بالتقاط ونكسر ونعبئ جوز الهند الصغير الطازج مباشرة من المصدر. بعد تنظيف جوز الهند، يتم تعقيم الماء الرقيق بالداخل بشكل فلاش (ويختلط أحيانًا مع الفواكه النقية الطبيعية) ثم يُسكب في عبوة تيترا ثابتة على الرف. لا تتجاوز العملية بأكملها من شجرة إلى باك 72 ساعة. نسمع أن النتيجة النهائية تشبه كثيرًا لصق المصاصة في جوز الهند.

Não muito tempo atrás, você tinha que usar um machete se você queria um gole de água pura de coco. Nós tiramos o facão da equação, o que é bom, porque essas coisas são perigosas. Agora tudo o que resta é o néctar mais hidratante, refrescante, rico em vitaminas e minerais. A Vita Coco nunca é feita de concentrado. Isso significa que pegamos, rachamos e embalamos cocos frescos diretamente na fonte. Depois que os cocos forem limpos, a delicada água interna é pasteurizada (e ocasionalmente misturada com purê de fruta natural) e depois despejada em uma Tetra Pak estável na prateleira. Todo o processo de árvore a Pak não excede 72 horas. Ouvimos que o resultado final é muito parecido colar um canudo em um coco.

不久前,如果您想要一口纯椰子水,您必须使用弯刀。 我们已经把弯刀带走了那种好处,因为这些东西是危险的。 现在剩下的就是大自然母亲最保湿、清爽、富含维生素和矿物质的花蜜。 Vita Coco 从来没有浓缩。 这意味着我们直接从源头采摘、开裂和包装新鲜的椰子。 清洁椰子后,内部的精致水会被快速巴氏消毒(偶尔与全天然水果泥混合),然后倒入稳定的利乐包。 从树到Pak 的整个过程不超过 72 小时。 我们听说最终的结果很像在椰子中粘一根吸管。

不久前,如果你想要一口純椰子水,你就必須使用彎刀 。 我們已經將大砍刀從方程中取出,這很好,因為那些東西很危險。 現在,剩下的是 Mother Nature 最保濕、清新、富含維他命和礦物質的花蜜。 Vita Coco 從未以濃縮材料製成。 這意味著我們直接在來源處挑選、開裂和包裝新鮮的椰子。 ​ 清潔椰子後,內部的精緻水會經過火烈巴氏殺菌 (偶爾會與全天然果泥混合),然後倒入擱架穩定的 Tetra Pak 利樂。 從樹到柏木的整個過程不超過 72 小時。 我們聽說最終的結果就像在椰子中粘一根吸管。

Vita Coco는 농축액으로 만들어지지 않았습니다. 즉, 우리가 신선한 어린 코코넛을 직접 고르고 균열하며 포장합니다. 코코넛을 씻은 후, 내부의 섬세한 물은 플래시 살균(그리고 때로는 천연 과일 퓨레와 혼합) 후 선반 안정적인 Tetra Pak에 붓습니다. 나무에서 팩까지 전체 과정은 72시간을 초과하지 않습니다. 최종 결과는 코코넛에 빨대를 붙이는 것과 같습니다.

We use the tastiest variety of coconuts in the world. To maintain their distinctive flavor, We grow our coconuts in isolation from other coconut varieties. Our young green coconuts are picked by hand after growing for six to seven months when the water and meat composition are appropriately balanced. During Harvest, the coconuts are lowered to the ground by rope to prevent damage. Then they are collected, often via boats traveling through canals that border The palms. While the process sounds picturesque, the reality is that this is very hard work. We have worked tirelessly with experienced experts and farmers in Thailand in order to sustain lasting organic coconut cultivation and prove that production does not need to be destructive.

description: Kissel or kisel (Estonian: kissell, Finnish: kiisseli, Latgalian: keiseļs, Latvian: ķīselis, Lithuanian: kisielius, Polish: kisiel, Russian: кисель, kisél’, Ukrainian: кисiль, Belarusian: кісель, kisél') is a viscous fruit dish, popular as a dessert and as a drink.[1][2] It consists of the sweetened juice of berries, like mors, but it is thickened with cornstarch, potato starch or arrowroot; sometimes red wine or fresh or dried fruits are added.[2] It is similar to the Danish rødgrød and German Rote Grütze.[1] Swedish blåbärssoppa is a similarly prepared bilberry dessert, although only fresh or frozen bilberries, not dried berries are used to prepare it.[original research?] Kissel can be served either hot or cold, also together with sweetened quark or semolina pudding. Kissel can also be served on pancakes or with ice cream. If the kissel is made using less thickening starch, it can be drunk — this is common in Russia and Ukraine.

description: Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

description: This essential water has traditionally been used in many French and Mediterranean dessert dishes, but has more recently found its way into Western cuisine. For example, orange flower water is used in France to flavor madeleines, in Mexico to flavor little wedding cakes, and in the United States to make orange blossom scones. Orange flower water is also used as an ingredient in some cocktails, such as the Ramos Gin Fizz. It has been a traditional ingredient used often in Middle Eastern cooking. In the Arab world, it is frequently added to hard or otherwise bad-tasting drinking water to mask the unpleasant flavor. Orange blossoms are believed to be used in this manner because they are seen as the traditional bridal flower and, therefore, symbolize purity (white, small and delicate).

bullet_point: [Cold Stored In Our Climate/Light Controlled Warehouse!, Made From Farm Fresh Kale!, One Tablespoon Equals Multiple Servings of Fresh Kale!]
description: Get over 100 single teaspoon servings from one pound of our farm fresh kale JUICE powder. Direct from the growers to our herb store comes this finely prepared vegetable superfood powder. Our kale JUICE powder is gently dried in low heat to preserve its nutrient composition. Just 1-2 teaspoons of this superfood JUICE powder in a daily health drink or smoothie adds a blast of healthy nutrients to your body! Our juice powders are many times more nutrient dense than our standard kale powder. What Is The Difference Between Standard Superfood Powders & Juice Powders? This is one question that we hear very often. Many people are a bit confused on the difference between our standard herb powders (e.g. Kale Powder, Acai Berry Powder, Wheatgrass Powder, etc.) and our juice powders (e.g. Kale Juice Powder, Acai Berry Juice Powder, Wheatgrass Juice Powder, etc.). To answer the question clearly, picture a bag full of fresh picked and dried kale and a glass of freshly squeezed kale juice. To make our standard berry powder the bag of kale is simply dried and ground up into a powder. To make our juice powder the kale is squeezed to first make the juice and then the juice is dried to make the juice powder. So how is the juice powder more nutrient dense? Well, let's say that it takes 5-10 lbs of kale to make 1 pound of kale powder. Take the same kale and figure that the same 5-10 lbs will make approx. 64 fluid ounces of kale juice. Now that juice is freeze dried to make only about 6-10 ounces or so of pure juice powder. So you see it takes a whole lot more kale to make our juice powders than our regular powders. See, it's really not that complicated after all.

description:
Not so long ago, you had to use a machete if you wanted a sip of pure coconut water. We’ve taken the machete out of the equation, which is good, because those things are dangerous. Now all that’s left is Mother Nature’s most hydrating, refreshing, vitamin- and mineral-rich nectar. Vita Coco is never made from concentrate. That means we pick, crack, and pack fresh young coconuts directly at the source. After the coconuts are cleaned, the delicate water inside is flash pasteurized (and occasionally mixed with all-natural fruit puree) then poured into a shelf-stable Tetra Pak. The entire process from tree to Pak doesn't exceed 72 hours. We hear the end result is a lot like sticking a straw in a coconut.

Nun ist alles, was übrig bleibt, der feuchtigkeitsspendendste, erfrischende, vitamin- und mineralreiche Nektar. Vita Coco wird nie aus Konzentrat hergestellt. Das heißt, wir pflücken, knacken und verpacken frische junge Kokosnüsse direkt an der Quelle. Nachdem die Kokosnüsse gereinigt wurden, wird das empfindliche Wasser im Inneren pasteurisiert (und gelegentlich mit naturbelassenem Fruchtpüree) und dann in ein regalstabiles Tetra-Pak gegossen. Der gesamte Prozess von Baum zu Pak beträgt 72 Stunden. Wir hören, dass das Endergebnis sehr ist, als würde man einen Strohhalm in eine Kokosnuss kleben.

Não muito tempo atrás, você tinha que usar um machete se você queria um gole de água pura de coco. Nós tiramos o facão da equação, o que é bom, porque essas coisas são perigosas. Agora tudo o que resta é o néctar mais hidratante, refrescante, rico em vitaminas e minerais. A Vita Coco nunca é feita de concentrado. Depois que os cocos forem limpos, a delicada água interna é pasteurizada (e ocasionalmente misturada com purê de fruta natural) e depois despejada em uma Tetra Pak estável na prateleira. description: Jin Ying Zi (Rosa laevigata) is a climbing rose native to fields, thickets, farms and low-elevation mountain areas in China. It was first brought to the U.S. in early colonial times. At one point, it acquired the common name of Cherokee rose (which it retains) in large part because it was being cultivated and widely distributed by Cherokee Indians. In 1916, under the mistaken belief that it was a U.S. native plant, it was designated as the state flower of Georgia. It has now naturalized throughout much of the southeastern U.S. from North Carolina to Florida west to Texas. This is an evergreen (in mild climates) climber that will grow to 6-20’ long on arching stems armed with hooked thorns. It also can be grown as a sprawling free-standing shrub. Stems are clad with trifoliate dark green leaves with coarsely toothed leaflets. Single, fragrant white flowers (to 4” diameter) with scalloped petals and yellow stamens bloom for several weeks in spring. Unfortunately there is no repeat bloom. Flowers are followed by large, bristly orange-red hips (to 2” long).

•Muscadine grapes (Vitis Rotundafolia) are a very sweet, large diameter and thick skinned grape native to North Carolina and parts of the Southeastern United States.
•The colors can range from black to bronze with the bronze variety sometimes being referred to as a scuppernong, which is a variety of muscadine.
•Muscadines grow in loose clusters and are typically harvested by picking individual berries unlike the viniferous varieties that are harvested in whole clusters.
• Muscadines have been present in North Carolina since the first settlers arrived here and they referred to them as Muscat because they were similar in taste to the French variety.
•This name eventually became known as a Muscadine, America’s only native grape and the North Carolina state fruit

•The muscadine grape contains one of the highest levels of antioxidant’s known to exist in any fruit according to recent studies.
•Antioxidants are key to combating free radicals in the body, free radicals have been implicated in contributing to many age related diseases and illnesses.
• Muscadines have been found to contain one of the highest levels of resveratrol, a naturally occurring antioxidant.
•With over 100 antioxidant’s present in the Muscadine grape it is a certainly a natural choice to live a healthy lifestyle.

description: Ingredients: Banana powder, creamer, Yogurt powder and sugar. What is Yogurt? Yogurt is a semisolid sourish food prepared from milk fermented by added bacteria, often sweetened and flavored. Here are just a few benefits of the countless benefits: Helps balance Probiotics for healthy digestion. Reported to help prevent Osteoporosis. Known to reduce the risk of high blood pressure. Helps overall digestive health. May help reduce hunger. Boosts your immune system. History of Yogurt: Yogurt making appears to have originated in the Middle East and Central Asia, even though researchers have been unable to pin down the exact time frame for this development. Camels, sheep, goats, and other animals were the primary sources of milk for yogurt since cows had yet to be domesticated. (In North America, buffalo and bison milk are two further examples of animal milks used to make yogurt prior to the domestication of cows.) Many cultures also developed techniques for drying their liquid yogurt so that it had a longer shelf life and could be more easily stored and transported. It became very common for certain nomadic cultures to rely on dried yogurt as part of their staple food. Today, cow's milk has become the primary source for commercially produced yogurt, and this food is enjoyed in fresh liquid form worldwide. Yogurt consumption in the U.S. is about 4 times greater than it was in the 1980's, and averages about 11-12 pounds per person per year. (This amount is much smaller than would be found in other parts of the world. For example, in Europe, yogurt consumption averages closer to 65-70 pounds per person). Nearly 4 billion pounds of yogurt are manufactured annually in the U.S. each year, and due to the increasing popularity of Greek-style yogurt, nearly 1.5 billion pounds are manufactured in that form.

It is reduced to a thick, molasses-like consistency, and rather than the bright red of the fresh fruit, it's a dark, syrupy mahogany color, sometimes with a slightly grainy texture. description: Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

title: Vita Coco Coconut Water, Pure, 33.8 Fl Oz
bullet_point: [Pure vitamin and mineral rich coconut water, Great source of potassium, fat and cholesterol free, Comes in eco- and socially-responsible Tetra Pak packaging, Kosher, gluten-free, and vegan-approved, Hydrate naturally]
description:
Not so long ago, you had to use a machete if you wanted a sip of pure coconut water. We've taken the machete out of the equation, which is good, because those things are dangerous. Now all that's left is Mother Nature's most hydrating, refreshing, vitamin- and mineral-rich nectar. Vita Coco is never made from concentrate. That means we pick, crack, and pack fresh young coconuts directly at the source. After the coconuts are cleaned, the delicate water inside is flash pasteurized (and occasionally mixed with all-natural fruit puree) then poured into a shelf-stable Tetra Pak. The entire process from tree to Pak doesn't exceed 72 hours. We hear the end result is a lot like sticking a straw in a coconut.

No hace mucho tiempo, tuviste que usar un machete si querías un sorbo de agua pura de coco. Hemos sacado el machete de la ecuación, lo cual es bueno, porque esas cosas son peligrosas. Ahora todo lo que queda es el néctar más hidratante, refrescante, rico en vitaminas y minerales. Vita Coco nunca está hecho de concentrado. Eso significa que recogemos, agrietamos y empacamos cocos jóvenes frescos directamente en la fuente. Después de limpiar los cocos, el delicado agua interior es pasteurizado (y de vez en cuando se mezcla con puré de fruta totalmente natural) y luego se vierte en un Tetra Pak estable en estante. Todo el proceso de árbol a Pak no supera las 72 horas. Oímos que el resultado final es mucho como pegar una paja en un coco.

לא כל כך מזמן, הייתם צריכים להשתמש במצ'טה אם רצית לגימה של מי קוקוס טהורים. הוצאנו את המצ'טה מהמשוואה, וזה טוב, כי הדברים האלה מסוכנים. עכשיו כל מה שנשאר הוא הצוף העשיר ביותר של אמא טבע, מרענן, בוויטמינים ומינרלים. Vita Coco אף פעם לא עשוי מתרכיז. זה אומר שאנחנו בוחרים, נסדקים, ואורזים אגוזי קוקוס טריים צעירים ישירות למקור. לאחר ניקוי אגוזי הקוקוס, המים העדינים בפנים מפוסטרים (ולפעמים מעורבבים עם מחית פירות טבעית) ואז נשפכים לתוך חבילת טטרה יציבה מדף. התהליך כולו מעץ ל-Pak אינו עולה על 72 שעות. אנחנו שומעים שהתוצאה הסופית דומה מאוד לתקוע קש בקוקוס.

Nun ist alles, was übrig bleibt, der feuchtigkeitsspendendste, erfrischende, vitamin- und mineralreiche Nektar. Vita Coco wird nie aus Konzentrat hergestellt. Das heißt, wir pflücken, knacken und verpacken frische junge Kokosnüsse direkt an der Quelle. Nachdem die Kokosnüsse gereinigt wurden, wird das empfindliche Wasser im Inneren pasteurisiert (und gelegentlich mit naturbelassenem Fruchtpüree) und dann in ein regalstabiles Tetra-Pak gegossen. Der gesamte Prozess von Baum zu Pak beträgt 72 Stunden. Wir hören, dass das Endergebnis sehr ist, als würde man einen Strohhalm in eine Kokosnuss kleben.

product description
Verjus (pronounced vair-ZHOO) is the tart, fresh juice of unripe wine grapes. It is a culinary ingredient indigenous to the world's wine producing regions that is used in sauce making, for poaching fish and meat, and to dress lettuces, vegetables and fruit. Verjus or "verjuice" as it is sometimes called, literally means green juice in the sense that it's made from fruit that has yet to fully ripen - it's green. It is used to add acidity to foods, an important component in food and in cooking. 
Napa Valley Verjus is made from white wine varieties such as Chardonnay, and the wine grapes removed from the vine in midsummer, at a point in the growing cycle called veraison. At veraison, change in color from green to black and the berries begin to soften enough to press. 

As the grapes arrive at the winery, they are loaded into large pneumatic presses where the juice is gently extracted then transferred to refrigerated stainless steel tanks. The juice is allowed to settle for a couple of days, then it is lightly filtered and packaged. 

The fresh verjus is at its best right after pressing, and can be packaged immediately. The challenging part of the production is keeping the verjus from fermenting and becoming wine; crushed grapes will spontaneously ferment due to airborne yeasts. 

Commercially, grape juice is usually stabilized by either adding powerful preservatives like benzoic acid, or by traditional canning methods - the juice must be heated to a temperature high enough to kill yeast cells and bacteria. Both of these methods adversely affect the taste of the finished product.

Freeze-drying is the use of low temperature to dry products in the drying chamber by sublimating water out of the products. The main principle of freeze drying process is maintaining the drying chamber temperature at about 0-10°C, creating difference in temperature and pressure inside and outside the product. At that point, the vapor in the product starts to evaporate and the product gradually dries up. When they are dried, the product will continue in the cooling and packaging stages. Freeze dried products are not fried or soaked with oil, so they will not get oily or caramelized. After drying, the product retains its natural flavor and is not brittle as when vacuum fried.

description: Jin Ying Zi (Rosa laevigata) is a climbing rose native to fields, thickets, farms and low-elevation mountain areas in China. It was first brought to the U.S. in early colonial times. At one point, it acquired the common name of Cherokee rose (which it retains) in large part because it was being cultivated and widely distributed by Cherokee Indians. In 1916, under the mistaken belief that it was a U.S. native plant, it was designated as the state flower of Georgia. It has now naturalized throughout much of the southeastern U.S. from North Carolina to Florida west to Texas. This is an evergreen (in mild climates) climber that will grow to 6-20’ long on arching stems armed with hooked thorns. It also can be grown as a sprawling free-standing shrub. Stems are clad with trifoliate dark green leaves with coarsely toothed leaflets. Single, fragrant white flowers (to 4” diameter) with scalloped petals and yellow stamens bloom for several weeks in spring. Unfortunately there is no repeat bloom. Flowers are followed by large, bristly orange-red hips (to 2” long).

It all started with a small family-owned Caribbean restaurant in Fayetteville, North Carolina. description: Buy our all natural pomegranate fruit powder in stock and on sale at Florida Herb House. Whether you choose our premium dried pomegranate fruit powder (made from dried pomegranate fruits) or our premium pomegranate juice powder (made from freeze dried pomegranate juice), they will both provide a wealth of phyto-nutrients, vitamins, antioxidants and minerals. Pomegranate is one of our best selling nutrient dense superfruit powders. The pomegranate fruit ranges in size from an orange to a large grapefruit. It has a leathery skin that must be peeled to reveal the hundreds of tiny red seeds. The seeds are entirely edible, crunchy, sweet and berry-like in flavor. Makes wonderful syrups, sauces and juice, or may be combined with other fresh fruits for exciting compotes. Rich in potassium. Every pomegranate is composed of exactly 840 seeds, each surrounded by a sac of sweet-tart juice contained by a thin skin. The seeds are compacted in a layer resembling honeycomb around the core. title: Mott's Mr. & Mrs. T's Sweet & Sour Mixer, 33.81-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)

New products like Mott's Plus juices and Mott's Organics apple sauce provide easy solutions for moms looking for smart snacks, Perfected with ripe orange flavor, Orange and lime flavors compliments each other perfectly with right amount of sweetner, Made from scratch taste]
description:
Mott's was founded in 1842 by Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, where he made cider. Mott's cider and vinegar caught on with his neighbors and, as demand grew, so did the size of his mill. Before the turn of the century Clipper ships were carrying Mott's champagne cider and casks of Mott's vinegar around Cape Horn to California. Mott's successfully exhibited their products at world fairs in Paris and Brussels. They promoted their wares at the Philadelphia Centennial of 1876 and the Chicago Columbian Exposition of 1893, picking up first prizes for quality. In 1900, the Mott Company merged with the W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott had been almost entirely in the cider and vinegar business then had an idea go into other fields such as champagne cider until Prohibition cut short its career. During the decade following acquisition of the Standard Apple Products Company and its plant in Hamlin, NY in 1929, Duffy-Mott introduced a series of new fruit products that contributed more to its growth than events of any prior decade. In 1930 apple sauce was added to the Mott line. In 1938, the company introduced Mott's apple juice. Because cider had become established as a purely seasonal item, it was believed that warehousing and other problems could be eased with a year-round apple juice. The company's production people and researchers went to work to develop processing techniques whereby the natural flavor and bouquet of apples could be captured in a bottle. Because of the location of its plants, Duffy-Mott had not been able to extend its Mott's lines west of the Rockies. But this changed in June of 1960, when the company leased the 407,000-square-foot plant and purchased all the processing equipment of the Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation from Thriftimart Inc., a West Coast food chain.

Mott fue fundada en 1842 por Samuel R. Mott en Bouckville, Nueva York, donde hizo sidra. La sidra y el vinagre de Mott atrapados con sus vecinos y, a medida que la demanda creció, también lo hizo el tamaño de su molino. Antes del cambio del siglo los barcos Clipper llevaban sidra de champán de Mott y barricas de vinagre de Mott alrededor del Cabo de Hornos a California. Mott exhibió con éxito sus productos en ferias mundiales de París y Bruselas. Ellos promovieron sus mercancías en el Centenario de Filadelfia de 1876 y la Exposición Columbiana de Chicago de 1893, recogiendo los primeros premios de calidad. En 1900, la Compañía Mott se fusionó con el W.B. Duffy Sidra Company de Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott había estado casi enteramente en el negocio de sidra y vinagre entonces tenía una idea ir a otros campos como la sidra de champán hasta que la prohibición corta su carrera. Durante la década posterior a la adquisición de Standard Apple Products Company y su planta en Hamlin, NY en 1929, Duffy-Mott introdujo una serie de nuevos productos frutales que contribuyeron más a su crecimiento que los eventos de cualquier década anterior. En 1930 se agregó salsa de manzana a la línea Mott. En 1938, la compañía introdujo el jugo de manzana de Mott. Debido a que la sidra se había establecido como un producto puramente estacional, se creía que el almacenamiento y otros problemas podían aliviarse con un jugo de manzana durante todo el año. La gente de producción de la compañía e investigadores fueron a trabajar para desarrollar técnicas de procesamiento por las cuales el sabor natural y el ramo de manzanas podían ser capturados en una botella. Debido a la ubicación de sus plantas, Duffy-Mott no había podido extender sus líneas de Mott al oeste de las Rocosas. Pero esto cambió en junio de 1960, cuando la compañía arrendó la planta de 407.000 pies cuadrados y compró todo el equipo de procesamiento de la Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation de Thriftimart Inc., una cadena alimentaria de la Costa Oeste.

Mott's wurde 1842 von Samuel R. Mott in Bouckville, New York, gegründet, wo er Apfelwein herstellte. Motts Apfelessig fangen sich mit seinen Nachbarn an und als Nachfrage wuchs, auch die Größe seiner Mühle. Vor der Jahrhundertwende trugen Clipper Schiffe Motts Champagnerwein und Fässer von Motts Essig um Cape Horn nach Kalifornien. Mott's stellte seine Produkte erfolgreich auf Weltmessen in Paris und Brüssel aus. Sie beförderten ihre Waren bei der Philadelphia Centennial von 1876 und der Chicago Columbian Exposition von 1893 und erhielten erste Preise für Qualität. Im Jahr 1900 verschmelzen die Mott Company mit dem W.B. Duffy Cider Company of Rochester, NY. Duffy-Mott war fast vollständig im Apfelessig und hat dann eine Idee in andere Bereiche wie Champagnerwein gegangen, bis das Prohibition kurz seine Karriere abbrachte. Während des Jahrzehnts nach dem Erwerb der Standard Apple Products Company und seiner Werk in Hamlin, NY im Jahr 1929, führte Duffy-Mott eine Reihe neuer Obstprodukte ein, die mehr zu ihrem Wachstum beitragen als Ereignisse aus jedem vorherigen Jahrzehnt. 1930 wurde Apfelsauce zur Mott-Linie hinzugefügt. 1938 führte das Unternehmen Mott's Apfelsaft ein. Da Apfelwein als rein saisonales Produkt etabliert wurde, wurde angenommen, dass die Lagerung und andere Probleme mit einem ganzjährigen Apfelsaft gelöst werden könnten. Die Produktionsleute und Forscher des Unternehmens haben sich an der Entwicklung von Verarbeitungstechniken gearbeitet, bei denen der natürliche Geschmack und das Bouquet von Äpfeln in einer Flasche festgehalten werden können. Wegen der Standort seiner Pflanzen war Duffy-Mott nicht in der Lage, die Linien von Mott westlich der Rockies zu erweitern. Aber dies veränderte sich im Juni 1960, als das Unternehmen die 407.000 Quadratfuß Anlage leihte und alle Verarbeitungsgeräte der Pratt-Low Preserving Corporation von Thriftimart Inc., einer Lebensmittelkette von West Coast kaufte.

This superfruit consists of an inner white flesh that has a sweet and tangy flavor, with a dark purple, bitter, and leathery outer rind. It is in the tough outer rind of the fruit where the polyphenols, including the xanthones and tannins can be found. These polyphenols are responsible for the fruit's survival properties. Genesis Today uses a special proprietary blending process to ensure we receive the beneficial antioxidants contained within the rind. The end result is our pure, and strong, organic mangosteen liquid super concentrate, that offers trace vitamins and minerals, and a generous amount of xanthones in every ounce.
Pure, Wild-Harvested & Organic
What makes our supplements so unique? We have only one ingredient: "100% pure superfruit." Each superfruit supplement is 100% pure superfruit juice derived entirely from the fruit, processed by traditional methods used in each country of origin. There are no additives or fillers, and we never dilute our supplements with water or fruit juices. They're simply 100% pure, USDA certified organic, wild-harvested superfruits from Genesis Today's Superfood Farms.
Suggested Use
As a liquid dietary supplement, take 1 fl oz in the morning and again in the afternoon. Additional 1 fl oz servings may be taken throughout the day if desired. Organic Mangosteen 100 can also be mixed with your favorite natural juice, or with our popular Organic Goji 100 for the "Ultimate Tonic."
